holdout: Do not open. No candidate passed development.
pass: After-cost return beats the matching buy-and-hold on development, with at least 30 trades and max drawdown under 40 percent.
fail: Loses to buy-and-hold, or profit factor under 1.0 after costs.
inconclusive: Fewer than 30 trades, or costs not modeled.
multipleTesting: Three BTC hypotheses were already tested. Do not retune them.
